skill.name: caveman-compress
skill.description: Compresses natural language memory files such as CLAUDE.md, todos, and preferences into a shorter caveman format. It preserves code blocks, URLs, headings, and technical terms while saving a .original.md backup before overwriting.
skill.summary: Compress AI memory files to reduce recurring context tokens while keeping a readable backup.
skill.author: juliusbrussee

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown backticks, documentation, validation regexes, and protective .env skip lists. Confirmed risks are the fixed Claude CLI subprocess fallback and the intentional transmission of selected memory file content to Claude for compression. No prompt injection attempt or hidden data collection was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: External transmission of memory file content
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before compression and recommend removing secrets or private customer data from memory files.
Document the trusted CLI requirement and consider verifying the resolved claude executable before invoking it.
Write compressed output to a temporary file and replace the target atomically only after validation succeeds.
Add confirmation for absolute paths outside the current project before reading and rewriting files.

content.user_title: Compress Memory Files for Token Savings
content.value_statement: Large memory files consume tokens every AI session. This skill compresses natural language files while preserving technical details and saving a readable backup.
actual_capabilities: Compresses natural language files with .md, .txt, .markdown, and .rst extensions.
Detects and skips common code, configuration, environment, lock, and backup files.
Saves the original file beside the compressed file as a .original.md backup.
Preserves headings, code blocks, inline code, URLs, file paths, commands, and technical terms.
Validates compressed output for headings, code blocks, URLs, paths, and bullet count changes.
Retries targeted Claude fixes up to two times when validation errors are found.
limitations: It sends selected file content to Claude through the Anthropic SDK or Claude CLI.
It overwrites the target file after creating a backup, so interrupted runs need review.
It is not intended for code, structured configuration, environment files, or lock files.
It requires Python 3.10 and working Claude or Anthropic authentication.

use_cases.title: Reduce Project Memory Cost
use_cases.description: Compress a large CLAUDE.md file so future AI sessions load fewer recurring tokens.
use_cases.target_user: Developers who use AI memory files daily

use_cases.title: Archive Preferences Compactly
use_cases.description: Shorten long preference notes while preserving technical terms, commands, and important structure.
use_cases.target_user: Power users with detailed assistant instructions

use_cases.title: Prepare Team Notes for Agents
use_cases.description: Compress markdown todos or project notes before they become shared context for AI coding tools.

prompt_templates.title: Compress Main Memory
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner compression of one memory file
prompt_templates.prompt: Compress CLAUDE.md with caveman-compress. Preserve headings, URLs, file paths, commands, and code blocks.

prompt_templates.title: Compress Preferences
prompt_templates.scenario: Compress a specific notes file and confirm validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Compress docs/preferences.md. Tell me whether validation passed and where the backup was saved.

prompt_templates.title: Compress With Recovery
prompt_templates.scenario: Use the retry flow for files that may contain mixed prose
prompt_templates.prompt: Compress todos.md. If validation fails, use targeted fixes only and leave the original content safe.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Then Compress
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before modifying a project memory file
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether project-notes.md is natural language. Compress it only if suitable, then report validation warnings.

output_examples.input: A user asks to compress a large project memory file.
output_examples.output: The skill reports that compression completed and identifies the compressed file plus the readable backup file.

output_examples.input: A user provides a configuration file by mistake.
output_examples.output: The skill skips the file because it is not natural language and leaves the file unchanged.

output_examples.input: Validation finds a missing URL after compression.
output_examples.output: The skill asks Claude to fix only the missing URL, validates again, and reports the final result.

best_practices: Review memory files for secrets before compression because file content is sent to Claude.
Edit the readable backup first, then rerun compression when memory instructions change.
Use the skill for prose-heavy markdown and text files, not code or structured configuration.
anti_patterns: Do not compress files that contain credentials, tokens, or private customer data.
Do not use the compressed file as the only editable source of important instructions.
Do not force compression on code, environment files, lock files, or machine-readable configuration.

faq.question: What files can this skill compress?
faq.answer: It supports natural language markdown, text, markdown, and reStructuredText files. It also handles extensionless prose files.

faq.question: Does it keep a backup?
faq.answer: Yes. It writes the original content to a .original.md file beside the compressed file.

faq.question: Does it modify code blocks?
faq.answer: It instructs Claude to preserve code blocks and inline code exactly, then validates code block preservation.

faq.question: Does it send file content outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends selected file content to Claude through the Anthropic SDK or Claude CLI.

faq.question: What happens if validation fails?
faq.answer: The skill retries targeted fixes up to two times. If validation still fails, it restores the original file.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
